brand_identity.name: Abhinav Sharma
brand_identity.vibe: White background, minimal yet playful and creative feel. Hand-drawn accents.

typography.heading: Outfit, sans-serif
typography.font_install_instructions: Import Outfit and Caveat from Google Fonts in index.css or next layout.

sections.name: Hero Section
sections.description: A 3-liner paragraph dominating the screen. Minimal, bold.
sections.layout: Min-height 80vh, flex items-center justify-center text-center or heavily left-aligned.
sections.micro_interactions: Framer motion stagger-children text reveal. Slight parallax on scroll.
elements: Include a subtle SVG hand-drawn squiggle floating near the text.

sections.name: Here's How Section
sections.description: A dummy art with moving arrows.
sections.layout: Grid or flex container with plenty of whitespace.
sections.micro_interactions: Animated SVG arrows moving along a path (use stroke-dasharray and framer-motion pathLength).
elements: Custom SVG component representing a minimal, playful flowchart. Use raw SVG with <path> elements that look hand-drawn (slight curves, imperfect lines).

sections.name: Case Study Section
sections.micro_interactions: Subtle hover animation: group-hover:scale-[1.02] transition-transform duration-300, image wrapper slightly zooms, perhaps a hand-drawn underline appears on the title.
elements: Card component: Borderless or 1px black border. Large image on top, title and minimal tags below.
Images: Use URLs provided in media_urls.

sections.name: Projects Section
sections.description: Showcase reels and videos in Masonry Layout with 'I experiment a lot' text in the middle. Video popup on click.
sections.layout: CSS columns-based masonry (columns-1 md:columns-2 lg:columns-3 gap-6). Ensure items avoid breaking across columns (break-inside-avoid).
sections.micro_interactions: Video cards have a playful hover state. Clicking opens a modal.
elements: Middle/Prominent Element: A block with hand-written text 'I experiment a lot' (using Caveat font).
Popup/Modal: Use Shadcn Dialog. When opened, it displays the video title, description, and an HTML5 <video> player.

sections.name: Process Section
sections.description: Journey like line from one corner to another with handdrawn spirals and step markings.
sections.layout: Relative container, full width, tall enough to allow the journey line.
sections.micro_interactions: Draw the SVG line on scroll (framer-motion useScroll & pathLength).
elements: Large SVG overlay covering the section. Path going from top-left to bottom-right.
At 3-4 points along the path, render an SVG spiral.
Absolute positioned text blocks near each spiral explaining the step.

sections.name: Footer Section
sections.description: Dummy art in center, philosophy on left, handdrawn social links on right.
sections.layout: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 items-center py-20 border-t border-black
sections.micro_interactions: Links jitter or slightly rotate on hover.
elements: Center: SVG dummy art (an abstract face, star, or geometric doodle).
Right: LinkedIn and Email links styled to look handdrawn (Caveat font, maybe wrapped in an SVG sketched box).

components.dialog: Use Shadcn UI Dialog for the video popup. Customize it to have a pure white background, 1px black border, and no rounded corners (or slightly rounded, max 8px).
components.icons: Use lucide-react. For hand-drawn elements, write raw inline SVGs.

micro_interactions_global.cursor: Optional custom cursor (a small black dot) or standard. Focus heavily on hover states: buttons shifting, text underlining, SVGs wiggling.
micro_interactions_global.testing: All clickable items (buttons, links, video cards) MUST have data-testid attributes.

projects_videos.title: Content Strategy Reel 1
projects_videos.description: A deep dive into scalable content frameworks.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the LIGHT theme with a white background and minimalist playful aesthetic.
Do NOT use typical corporate SaaS layouts. Rely on ample white space.
Use framer-motion extensively to achieve the micro-interactions described.
Implement the hand-drawn elements using raw SVG paths directly in the React components (e.g. for arrows, journey line, and spirals).
Ensure the projects masonry layout does not look like a standard uniform grid; vary the aspect ratios.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes for testing.
